newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hysan Causeway Bay office 50 pct leased.
newsitem.headline: Hysan Causeway Bay office 50 pct leased.

text.p: Hysan Development Co Ltd said on Tuesday its 50-storey Lee Gardens office tower in Hong Kong's central Causeway Bay district was more than 50 percent leased at an average rent of HK$40 per square foot.
In a statement, Hysan said there were a number of prospective tenants negotiating for the rest of the space.

"Many of these tenants have indicated that they took large amounts of space to cater for future growth rather than wait and pay more for additional space following the rise in Grade A rentals which is predicted to occur over the next two to three years," Hysan property director Pauline Wong said.

The complex comprises a 39-storey tower providing 700,000 square feet of Grade A office space in 16,200 to 18,600 square foot floorplates as well as a shopping arcade and basement carpark, Hysan said.
